post.title: [HIRING] Stripe subscriptions for our SaaS - $60/hr, need someone this week
post.body:
Our app (Node + React) currently takes one-off payments with Stripe Checkout. We need monthly and yearly plans, a customer portal for plan changes, and webhooks that update our Postgres. Our launch is next Monday so I need someone who can start in the next couple of days.

$60/hr, est. 15-20 hours.

analysis.summary: Add Stripe subscription plans, a customer portal and webhook handling to a Node/React SaaS before a launch next Monday.

expect: mentions subscriptions, webhooks or the customer portal
says it can start this week
does not invent a launch date or hours
